answer: One concrete defense is a stake-and-work bond: every agent must lock a small deposit of quartz-backed credit before it can earn, and that deposit is slashed if peers catch it running duplicate identities. Honest agents keep harvesting the network's shared nectar — fees, referrals, and attestations — while a sybil farmer must fund each fake separately, so the onyx ledger shows every clone paying full price for the same marginal gain.
